_comment: Which FROM address the send bridge uses per Morning Worker lane, and how many cold sends each alias may carry per day while it warms. Read by send_server.py on every /send (no restart needed). All aliases send through the ONE login in bsg_gmail.key (alejandro@bsgflorida.com + app password); Gmail signs DKIM with the alias domain because each alias is registered under Send-mail-as. If the login is NOT a bsgflorida.com account (old gmail.key), the map is ignored and everything goes out as the login, exactly as before. Lane keys match WORKER_LANES in tracker_template.html; the worker passes meta.wl. Strategy: the closer a lead is to a real conversation, the closer to the brand domain. replied = they wrote back, urgent = sale inside 7 days (small, time-critical, personalized) -> bsgflorida.com, capped. active = sale 8-45 days, the bulk cold lane -> biscaynesolutionsgroup.com. early = fresh lis pendens, largest and coldest -> bsgfl.com. Ramp is days since ramp_start -> sends per alias per day; the last entry holds forever. main_domain_cap protects bsgflorida.com regardless of ramp.
